visible_text: 前回の設定でその場で録り始めます
短すぎて、拾えたものはありません

answers.q1: A meeting recording that was just started has already ended (labeled '02:59 の会議', today, 0 minutes), and the home/dashboard screen is showing it in a 'recent meetings' list with a note that nothing useful was captured because it was too short.
answers.q2: The recent meeting card's status line: '短すぎて、拾えたものはありません' (too short, nothing was captured) — this tells the user the recording produced no usable result.
answers.q3: Start a new recording via '録音を始める', type a task/goal into the '何を終わらせますか？' input box, click into the meeting card for more detail, or navigate to Tasks/Meetings/Library/Agents/Plugins in the sidebar.
answers.q4: Not clearly — the app reports the recording was too short to capture anything, but there is no visible confirmation that this is expected behavior (e.g., a duration threshold) versus a malfunction, so a first-time user can't be sure the AI processed things correctly or just failed silently.
answers.q5: The 'Agents' and 'Plugins' sidebar items feel unnecessary/unexplained on a first encounter, and the '自分だけ' / 'プロジェクト無し' tags on the meeting card add clutter without clear value for a nearly-empty result.
answers.q6: The bold greeting 'こんばんは' at the top, then quickly down to the bold '02:59 の会議' title in the recent meeting card.

weaknesses.what: The message '短すぎて、拾えたものはありません' reads ambiguously as either a normal outcome (recording too short by design) or a failure, with no icon/state to disambiguate.
weaknesses.fix: Add a distinct visual state (e.g., muted icon or explanatory tooltip) that clarifies this is an expected outcome for very short recordings, not an error.

weaknesses.what: There is no visible transition or confirmation moment marking that the just-finished recording ended and produced this specific card — it just appears in a static list.
weaknesses.fix: Show a brief transient confirmation (toast or highlight animation) when a recording ends, linking the just-completed action to its resulting card.

weaknesses.what: The completed-meeting state is flat and slightly discouraging (empty result, generic tags), giving no positive reinforcement even though the user just finished a task.
weaknesses.fix: Soften the empty-result state with encouraging copy or a suggested next action (e.g., 'try recording longer next time') instead of a bare negative statement.
